scope: Descriptive offline statistics of recorded 50 Hz endpoints, not physical replay or a new admission decision.

sampling.absence_duration_method: Sum each sampled-absent endpoint's preceding control interval; this is an estimate, not continuous observation.
sampling.force_source: controller.hand_forces_n: recorded per-hand sums of actual contact-force magnitudes; annotations are not independent evidence.
sampling.stage_source: Controller annotations only partition statistics; legality comes from the recorded environment move log and statuses.

release.hold_evidence: Recorded environment commitment attests its per-physics-step hold; samples alone do not reconstruct it.
